_note: Which slice diseases each ClinicalTrials.gov record actually studies. 'snippets' must string-match the raw API record (build verifies). Records that only mention a gene as a protein biomarker (e.g. SNAP-25 in Alzheimer CSF), as a botulinum-toxin target, or in an unrelated disease are excluded here and listed in 'excluded'.

NCT01238250.note: Simons Searchlight online registry/natural history study; enrols by genetic diagnosis across 100+ genes (SNAP25/VAMP2 coverage is from the Simons Searchlight website, not the CT.gov condition list).

NCT04937062.note: Single protocol with a shared STXBP1/SLC6A1 arm: (likely) pathogenic STXBP1 or SLC6A1 variant.

snippets.SLC6A1: Confirmed diagnosis of SLC6A1-related disorder based on a pathogenic or likely pathogenic variant in the SLC6A1 gene

NCT07847918.note: Fully remote (site-less) phenylbutyrate feasibility trial; requires a (likely) pathogenic SLC6A1 variant.

NCT06967727.note: Epilepsy-dyskinesia registry; eligibility lists ~100 genes including STXBP1 and VAMP2.

NCT06585605.note: Retrospective multicentre epilepsy-dyskinesia survey; eligibility gene list includes STXBP1 and VAMP2.

snippets.SYT1: Genetically confirmed diagnosis of Baker Gordon syndrome.

NCT06399952.note: Requires a genetically confirmed Baker-Gordon syndrome (SYT1) diagnosis.

NCT07329257.note: Project PENGUIN: rare/ultra-rare NDD cohort; lists Baker Gordon Syndrome / Syt-1 disorder as conditions.

NCT02562066.note: Genetically confirmed CMS of several types, explicitly including SYT2 and SNAP25B deficiency.

NCT05161494.note: Gait pilot study enrolling people with STXBP1 (and tuberous sclerosis complex).

snippets.STXBP1: pathogenic or likely pathogenic variant in main synaptopathy genes (SYNGAP1 and STXBP1)

NCT05232630.note: Group 1A requires a (likely) pathogenic SYNGAP1 or STXBP1 variant.

snippets.SLC6A1: with a documented history of an SLC6A1 mutation

NCT07531511.note: Industry (UCB) prospective natural history study; documented SLC6A1 mutation, age <=17.

snippets.STXBP1: confirmation of a pathogenic or likely pathogenic STXBP1 gene mutation

NCT06983158.note: Requires a (likely) pathogenic STXBP1 variant; age 18 months to <8 years.

snippets.SLC6A1: Confirmation of pathogenic mutation S295L in the SLC6A1 gene

NCT07173153.note: Single-patient (n=1) AAV9 gene therapy; requires SLC6A1 S295L.

snippets.STXBP1: participant has a (likely) pathogenic, disease-causing STXBP1 variant

NCT06625112.note: ESCO registry/natural history; (likely) pathogenic STXBP1 variant or a structural variant including STXBP1.

Presence of a STXBP1 or SYNGAP1 gene mutation.
